description: Turns an incoming clock into a 0-10V phasor, with one cycle of the ramp spread across a chosen number of clock pulses

params.text: Sets how many clock pulses make up one cycle of the ramp, 1 to 64 in whole numbers, and 4 from new
Attenuverts the pulses per cycle CV input, -1 to +1; 5V at full depth covers the whole 1 to 64 range
Press to restart the ramp at the beginning of its cycle

inputs.text: Modulates the number of clock pulses per cycle
The clock the ramp follows; its rate divided by the pulses per cycle setting gives the cycle rate
A rising edge restarts the ramp at the beginning of its cycle

outputs.text: The ramp itself, rising from 0V to 10V across the set number of clock pulses
A 10V trigger on the sample where the ramp completes a cycle
